title: Sigismund August, Frater Georg and Queen Isabella to Ibrahim Pasha, 1548 (HHStA Wien StAbt Türkei I 7-4-4, 7-4-5, 7-4-9; catalogue 885)

documents.shelfmark: Wien, Haus-, Hof- und Staatsarchiv, StAbt Türkei I 7-4-4 (AIS 7040827), f. 28-30
documents.route: Sigismund August (Cracow) -> Ibrahim Pasha, copy sent to Ferdinand I by Malvezzi

plaintext.source: The Latin exemplar on f. 30 (image 4) filed with the two cipher copies (f. 28, f. 29).

transcription.notes: f. 29 (copy A) transcribed sign by sign, 13 lines, 572 signs including 21 null words, by two image agents on 30 Oct 2026 (transcription/f29_lines_01-07.txt, f29_lines_08-13.txt). The agents had the Latin exemplar open, so values marked * come from it and unmarked values may be biased toward it; a blind re-transcription has not been made. f. 28 and the 7-4-5 copies not transcribed. Blind check of lines 8-10: 61.4% match against the exemplar vs 99.2% crib-assisted (transcription/blind/RESULT.md); use 61% as the independent fit.

documents.shelfmark: Wien, Haus-, Hof- und Staatsarchiv, StAbt Türkei I 7-4-5 (AIS 7040824), f. 31-34
documents.route: Frater Georg (Vinea) -> Ibrahim Pasha, copy sent to Ferdinand I by Malvezzi

plaintext.source: The Latin exemplars B and C on f. 34 (image 5) and its continuation (image 6).

transcription.notes: Cipher not yet transcribed. Exemplar C transcribed in texts/exemplar_7-4-5_C.txt.

system.summary: Graphic-sign homophonic cipher with nulls and a code list, apparently the Ferdinand-Malvezzi key of 1548 (DECODE R367); not yet tested.
system.notes: The first line of 7-4-4 f. 29 begins with the Latin-letter words Idcirco, b, d, which are nulls of the R367 key (../malvezzi1548/KEY_BRIEF.md); same sign repertoire on the page. Unverified until a line is decoded.

prior_solution.where: No decipherment found in the repository, the DECODE list, the AIS descriptions or by web search (checked 29 Oct 2026). Austro-Turcica 1541-1552 pp. 276-278 not seen.

conditions.human_role: Daniel Bourdeau asked for the target to be started after a contributor's pull request (#196) reported the images unreachable; no target-specific intervention.

solution.what: Contributor report (PR #196, Harrison Bornstein): AIS records are Reservatbestand, no images reachable; candidate key = malvezzi1548 R367. No decipherment found in the repository, the DECODE list, AIS or on the web.
Re-tested image access: the detail.aspx session cookie plus getimage.aspx returns the full scans despite 'Reservatbestand'. Fetched all 22 images of the three records.
Transcribed the Latin exemplars of 7-4-4 (f. 30) and 7-4-5 (exemplar C, f. 34) from the images.

Compared the first line of 7-4-4 f. 29 with the R367 key brief: Idcirco, b, d are listed nulls and the graphic signs match; the exemplar (about 560 letters) is the same order of length as the 13 cipher lines.
Cut 13 lines of f. 29 into 26 half-line crops (2x) and had two image agents transcribe them sign by sign, with the R367 key brief and the exemplar as crib; 572 signs, 80 sign labels, 6 left unknown.

Decoded f. 29 with the R367 values and aligned the result on the Latin exemplar (global alignment, align_f29.py). The cipher is the exemplar's text from 'Sigismundus Augustus' on, preceded by a short extra passage: 462 of 473 key-derived tokens (97.7%) match; 56 tokens depend on the exemplar and are not counted. The exemplar's heading is not enciphered.

Tabulated sign label against value: 80 labels, 15 with more than one value, the rest consistent. Two values differ from KEY_BRIEF.md (r and x look reversed; some pi and cup forms). No independent (blind) transcription has been made, so the match rate is an upper bound.

Blind check: one image agent transcribed f. 29 lines 8-10 from the crops and the R367 key files only (no exemplar, no crib). Against the exemplar segment its values match 70 of 114 scored tokens (61.4%), against 99.2% for the crib-assisted values of the same lines; the two transcriptions agree on 61 of 142 values. The key family is confirmed without the crib, but the earlier 97.7% overstated the independent fit.

outcome.method_basis: Cipher not yet transcribed or decoded.
